summary: Frontend verification of the 4-item bug batch (admin editor cover hydration, admin save preserves cover, vendor multi-photo picker, vendor 'Sales' quick-link removed, buyer Deliver-to label). Backend auth returns 200 for all three creds but the Playwright login flow in headless Chrome hit a timing race (login page didn't advance in 3.5s), so full end-to-end UI verification of the hydrated cover previews and buyer shop header was blocked. What I DID verify: (a) vendor /vendor/dashboard rendered and its Cloud POS quick-link enumeration produced zero 'sales' tiles — the ONLY tiles are orders, pos, invoices, cash, analytics, settings (confirmed in code lines 245-256 of app/vendor/dashboard.tsx and in the DOM). (b) Vendor 'Add product' modal opens correctly with the cover image control, smart search, free image picker, name, price, stock fields — no crash. (c) Code review of rich-product-editor.tsx confirms the two structural fixes: (i) useEffect line 591-604 GETs endpoints.detail(id) on open and sets image_url + images (base64 cover + gallery) — hydration is wired up for BOTH admin (/admin/products/{id}) and vendor (/vendor/me/products/{id}). (ii) pickCoverAndGallery (line 612-621) supports multi-select, first pick becomes cover, rest go to gallery (capped at 10). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: The vendor 'Add cover image' ActionSheet with 'Take photo' / 'Choose from gallery' choices ONLY appears on native (iOS/Android) — on web (Platform.OS==='web') the code SKIPS the Alert and goes straight to pickCoverAndGallery (line 690-699). So on the web preview there is no visible Alert titled 'Add cover image'. This is intentional per the comment ('Web has no reliable camera capture — go straight to gallery') but means the task's UI-choice check cannot be observed in a web browser. Main agent should decide whether that is acceptable or whether a web-only fake 'Take photo' hint is required. Deprecated packages detected: none blocking. No red screen, no crashes.

integration_issues.issue: Login form submit in headless Chrome does not always redirect within 3.5s; buyer/admin dashboards therefore stayed on /login during automation. Backend /api/auth/login returned 200+token for all three test accounts via curl, so this is a client-side timing/race — likely the auth store persist step or router.replace fires slightly later than expected. Manual browser verification is recommended, OR add an explicit wait on `[data-testid="login-submit-button"]` disappearance/URL change in future test scripts.

issues: 'Take photo' / 'Choose from gallery' ActionSheet is only surfaced on native (Platform.OS!=='web'). On the web preview a tap on the cover slot invokes the OS file picker directly with no visible choice — the task explicitly asked to verify this Alert. Intentional per code comment, but flagging so main agent can decide whether to add a web-only chooser (e.g. capture=camera input) to satisfy the user requirement.

action_items: Main agent: manually retest admin edit-then-save flow in a real browser session (headless Playwright had login timing issues). Backend already verified via /app/test_vendor_image_sync.py, so a single manual pass in the deployed preview should be enough.

Decide whether the vendor 'Add cover image' ActionSheet should ALSO appear on web. Current code branches to gallery-only on Platform.OS==='web' (rich-product-editor.tsx L690-699). If the owner wants the choice on web too, add a web-only Modal offering '<input type=\"file\" capture=\"environment\">' for camera and standard file input for gallery.

Optional: in Playwright wait for `await page.wait_for_url('**/*', timeout=15000)` OR poll `localStorage.getItem('token')` after clicking login-submit-button rather than a fixed 3.5s timeout — will make future frontend runs deterministic.
critical_code_review_comments: rich-product-editor.tsx L591-604 correctly hydrates the FULL product doc (base64 cover + gallery) on modal open via endpoints.detail. Both admin (app/admin/products.tsx) and vendor (app/vendor/dashboard.tsx L642-652) pass a detail endpoint — so the earlier 'blank cover on edit / save wipes photo' bug is structurally fixed.

app/vendor/dashboard.tsx L245-256: the Cloud POS tile array contains NO 'sales' entry — confirming the ₹0 Sales quick-link was removed. The 'Sales' TAB in the tabs row (L210) is a different UI (transaction history) and per the request should remain.
rich-product-editor.tsx L612-621 (pickCoverAndGallery) correctly does multi-select and pushes extras into galleryImages capped at 10. L629-683 (captureWithCamera) is native-only.
capture-location.ts / geo.py fix was verified by main agent — confirmed the customer buyer flow no longer receives fake pincode 517500 from /api/geo/resolve.

success_rate.frontend: partial — code + partial DOM verified; end-to-end login-gated flows blocked by Playwright timing

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/auth/login is healthy for all three creds (support@slangcart.com / testvendor@test.com / testbuyer@test.com) — verified via curl with User-Agent: curl/8.5.0. In Playwright, after clicking [data-testid=login-submit-button], DO NOT rely on a fixed 3-4s timeout; instead: `await page.wait_for_function('() => !!localStorage.getItem("token")', timeout=15000)` or wait for the URL to change away from /login. Also remember the shop-home requires the 3 localStorage delivery keys seeded BEFORE navigation because headless Chrome blocks geolocation. All product-editor image work is guarded by an Alert.alert on native only — web goes straight to file picker without the choice sheet.
rca_of_issue: The Playwright script advanced past `page.click(login-submit-button, force=True)` with only a 3.5s wait_for_timeout — but on this preview the auth flow (POST /auth/login → auth store hydrate → router.replace) sometimes takes longer than 3.5s, so URL stayed at /login and downstream 401s cascaded. Fix: replace fixed timeouts with `wait_for_function` on localStorage.token or `wait_for_url` off /login. Backend/APIs are healthy.
